jobs.description:
Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

Jobomschrijving

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

Are you an organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys being at the heart of office life? In this part-time role, you will support the daily operations of a busy international office, ensuring employees and visitors enjoy a seamless and welcoming workplace experience.
 

Client Details

Our client is an internationally active organisation with offices across multiple countries. Their Brussels team operates in a professional, collaborative and multicultural environment where efficiency, excellent service and teamwork are key to success.

As the organisation continues to grow, they are looking for a reliable Office Operations Assistant to help maintain smooth day-to-day office activities and provide essential administrative support.

 

Description

• Act as the first point of contact for visitors, answering calls and welcoming guests professionally.
• Provide administrative support including data entry, document preparation, proofreading and reporting.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, catering arrangements and logistics for internal meetings and events.
• Manage office supplies, kitchen stock, consumables and general workplace organisation.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, deliveries and courier services.
• Support facilities-related requests and liaise with external suppliers when needed.
• Assist with access badge administration, workspace set-up and daily office inspections.
• Prepare the office for opening and help maintain a clean, organised and professional working environment.
 

• You have at least 1 year of experience in administration, office coordination, reception or workplace support.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word and Excel.
• You communicate fluently in English. Knowledge of French and/or Dutch is considered an asset.
• You are highly organised, proactive and able to multitask effectively.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy supporting both colleagues and visitors.
• You are hands-on and willing to assist with practical office and facilities-related tasks.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to work independently.
• You are available to work on-site in Brussels on a part-time basis, Monday to Friday from 9AM to 1PM.

Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. • Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.

Compliance & Documentation

• Professional level in Dutch, French and English

• Primarily focused on indirect procurement, with strong exposure to operational and industrial activities.

As an Operator in Hot Kitchen Department, you are responsible for independently operating various production machines. In this department, ingredients and prepared products are fried, cooked, steamed, mixed, and boiled.

What does the job involve?

As a Kitchen Operator, you are the right-hand person of the Team Leader in the Hot Kitchen Department, supporting them in the production of prepared dishes and food components.

You are responsible for preparing and carrying out recipes. Your tasks include:
